name: DrFeesh (he/him)
bio:
DrFeesh is an Admin on Silver Springs Survival and contributes as a builder and European community representative. He originally found the server through MinecraftServers and joined with a group of friends. After they eventually moved on, the strength of the community—and the regular map resets—gave him plenty of reasons to stay.

DrFeesh especially enjoys the server’s custom late-game content, including Trials of Valor, Valor gear, and custom enchantments. One of his favorite memories is the infamous Pickle Crash of ’29. If you were there, you know.

He helped build the newest spawn and enjoyed experimenting with display entities for the first time. He also has fond memories of Mushmarket, a custom marketplace built on a mushroom island for the community.

Outside of Minecraft, DrFeesh enjoys Cities: Skylines. He would like new players to know that the staff are friendly, helpful, and definitely don’t bite.
history: DrFeesh became a Moderator April 24th, 2020, alongside CubicBits, and LunaPotato. On August 25th, 2026, DrFeesh was promoted to Admin.
